reviews.rationale: Sequential comparison of selected Q2 and Q3 SEC exhibit rows shows a mixed picture rather than a clean directional signal. Core net interest income after provision rose, with net interest income up and the provision increase only partly offsetting it, while the interest expense increase outpaced the interest income increase, so the net interest margin path is not established by these rows. Noninterest income fell, driven by a swing in the signed investment securities gain/loss line from a gain to a loss, and noninterest expense rose, so pretax income, net income and common net income all declined sequentially on a GAAP basis. The company-defined non-GAAP operating common income also declined, and the non-GAAP reconciliation components grew, so the decline is not merely a GAAP-versus-non-GAAP artifact; the non-GAAP measure still exceeds GAAP common income in both periods. Preferred dividends rose, widening the gap between net income and common net income. Credit indicators are the main opposing evidence: net charge-offs and the charge-off rate rose, and nonaccrual and restructured loans and their ratio rose materially, while loans over ninety days past due declined slightly, so early-stage and late-stage indicators diverge. Income tax expense declined in absolute terms alongside lower pretax income, which is consistent with a lower tax base rather than a reduced tax burden; no effective tax rate is in the selected rows. All figures are sequential displayed-value arithmetic on selected rows, not year-over-year comparisons, and none of the movements is attributed to a stated cause. The selected extract contains no balance-sheet totals, average loan or deposit balances, net interest margin, efficiency ratio, capital ratios, allowance coverage, guidance, or management commentary, and no consensus expectations, so no beat/miss or valuation conclusion is supportable. Because the evidence is mixed, incomplete on the drivers of the securities swing and the nonaccrual increase, and lacks the source detail needed to distinguish temporary from persistent effects, the research state is held for review rather than advanced; conviction and status are preserved and downstream decisions remain blocked pending a complete, conflict-free source set for the same period.
